sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Balenpyre was invoked by [[Kiel]] to fight against [[Dante Vale]]. Balenpyre and Dante's [[Elf King Oberon]] were evenly matched as Balenpyre's fist and Oberon's sword collided. Both Titans were sent back to their Amulets. {{source|The Titan in the Temple of Sun}}

Balenpyre again was invoked alongside [[Vulcana]] during the [[Blood Spiral]] assault on the [[Fortress of Iron Will]]. The Titan trapped [[Sophie Casterwill]] in a flame ring, but she was freed when [[Sorcerel]] became [[Powerbonded]] and used her Armor Force ability to protect against the triple assault. Balenpyre was defeated when Sophie managed to face her fears and invoke the [[Legendary Titan]] of Valor, [[Mythras]], who slammed Balenpyre into the ground. {{source|The Spiral War}}

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.text:
with flames]]
Balenpyre is able to create fire and to use it as a weapon. Its mastery over fire is evident in its ability to create powerful fire balls, breathe fire, and even create entire rings of fire [The Spiral War]. Due to his large size, Balenpyre also possesses great strength. Due to his body being covered in flames, physical contact with an enemy Titan such as a punch can also burn the opponent in addition to the damage caused by Balenpyre's own offensive powers [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]. His body is made of a very resistant volcanic rock. [Giochi Preziosi]

* Balenpyre is based on a [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cherufe Cherufe], an evil humanoid creature made of rock and magma.
* Balenpyre's name may be based on the Dutch and Swedish word ''balen'' and the English word ''pyre''. ''Balen'' refers to a bale or a ball , and a pyre is a pile of flammable material on which dead bodies are cremated.

full_text:
Balenpyre is a large, golem-like Litho-Titan possessing a single, large eye on its demon-horned head. Its body is composed of vulcanic rock and lava. Balenpyre's Amulet is in the possession of Kiel.

== History ==
Balenpyre was invoked by Kiel to fight against Dante Vale. Balenpyre and Dante's Elf King Oberon were evenly matched as Balenpyre's fist and Oberon's sword collided. Both Titans were sent back to their Amulets. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

Balenpyre again was invoked alongside Vulcana during the Blood Spiral assault on the Fortress of Iron Will. The Titan trapped Sophie Casterwill in a flame ring, but she was freed when Sorcerel became Powerbonded and used her Armor Force ability to protect against the triple assault. Balenpyre was defeated when Sophie managed to face her fears and invoke the Legendary Titan of Valor, Mythras, who slammed Balenpyre into the ground. [The Spiral War]

== Abilities ==

Its mastery over fire is evident in its ability to create powerful fire balls, breathe fire, and even create entire rings of fire [The Spiral War]. Due to his large size, Balenpyre also possesses great strength. Due to his body being covered in flames, physical contact with an enemy Titan such as a punch can also burn the opponent in addition to the damage caused by Balenpyre's own offensive powers [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]. His body is made of a very resistant volcanic rock. [Giochi Preziosi]
